annotations.text:
Three treatments of the same screen. Colour, type scale and layout are identical across all three — only roundness, border usage, spacing rhythm and motion change.

A is the app exactly as it is today.

A — Current
3/5/8px radii. Every container outlined at 1px. Pane inset 24/48, block rhythm 16. Motion: hover colour only, nothing eases.

B — Softened  (recommended)
8/12/16px radii. Outlines give way to raised surfaces. Inset 20/40, rhythm 14. Rows settle in and ease on hover.

Same density of information, noticeably less hard edge.

C — Compact
B's roundness, pushed on density: topbar 38→32, sidebar 260→232, type down a rung (13→12, 25→21). Three more notes visible.

Tradeoff: 12px body is tight for long reading.

The settings modal, shown in treatment B.

Obsidian-shaped: scrim, category rail, pane. It stops taking over the main pane — your note stays visible behind it.

Sync is listed but marked, rather than a dead control.
